title: MFD-12 LearningProgress
description: Personal learning progress state for a specific module within a path. Stored locally in IndexedDB only; never bundled or synced. Defined per WS-D Q29 resolution.

userId.description: Local device user identifier (or 'default' for single-user mode)

moduleId.description: Reference to LearningModule.id; must be member of referenced LearningPath.moduleIds[]

status.description: Current progress state for this module

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when user first started this module

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when user completed this module

lastActiveAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent activity on this module

timeSpentSeconds.description: Cumulative time spent on this module in seconds

attempts.description: Number of quiz or completion attempts

notes.description: Personal reflection or notes on this module

crossReferenceIntegrityRules: LearningProgress.moduleId → MUST exist in LearningModule.id AND be member of LearningPath.moduleIds[]
